decisions.reason: A high-resolution piezo inkjet printer is a core product line for an established industrial marking firm like REA, and it was launched only recently, so it is very unlikely to be withdrawn within a year.
The numbering software module extends the firm's existing inkjet portfolio at low maintenance cost and supports hardware sales, so the firm has every reason to keep it.
Inkjet coders for non-absorbent surfaces serve steady packaging and industrial demand and fit the firm's core coding business, so dropping it soon after launch is unlikely.
